frequency_question: How often do major legislative priorities championed by majority party principals successfully pass their chamber of origin?
membership_rule: Includes major partisan bills prioritized by legislative leadership for floor votes; excludes non-controversial consensus bills and purely symbolic measures never brought to a vote.

cases.name: American Health Care Act house floor push 2017
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act passage 2017
Build Back Better Act house passage 2021
Lower Energy Costs Act HR 1 passage 2023
The For the People Act house passage 2021

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named high-profile partisan priorities; all successfully cleared their originating chamber when leadership willed it.
known_gaps: Excludes bills that leadership quietly dropped before introduction due to internal caucus fractures.
skeleton: Major party-line priority bills reaching floor consideration across recent congresses
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named major partisan priority test cases where leadership actively drove the effort
validity_reason: Bound to the stability of current legislative polarization dynamics and party discipline structures through the current congressional era.
